name: Zoom Plugin
description: Claude plugin for planning, building, and debugging Zoom integrations across REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, bots, and MCP workflows.
longDescription:
Ships **33 skills** and **7 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (33): `build-zoom-bot` (Build a Zoom meeting bot, recorder, or real-time media workflow), `build-zoom-meeting-app` (Build or embed a Zoom meeting flow), `choose-zoom-approach` (Choose the right Zoom architecture for a use case), `cobrowse-sdk` (Reference skill for Zoom Cobrowse SDK), `contact-center` (Reference skill for Zoom Contact Center), `debug-zoom` (Debug a broken Zoom integration by isolating the failure point and routing into the right Zoom references), `debug-zoom-integration` (Debug broken Zoom implementations quickly), `design-mcp-workflow` (Design a Zoom MCP workflow for Claude), and 25 more
- **MCP servers** (7): `zoom-mcp`, `zoom-meetings-mcp`, `zoom-canvas-mcp`, `zoom-chat-mcp`, `zoom-tasks-mcp`, `zoom-revenue-accelerator-mcp`, `zoom-whiteboard-mcp`

Installs with `claude plugin install zoom-plugin@claude-plugins-official` from `zoom/zoom-plugin`.
